title: Tango Therapeutics Reports 82% Tumor Response Rate for Vopimetostat Combination in Advanced Pancreatic Cancer at ESMO 2026
detail: STAT News reported on October 23, 2026 that Tango Therapeutics presented ESMO 2026 trial results for vopimetostat in combination therapy for advanced pancreatic cancer, with an 82% tumor response rate. Details beyond the reported headline figure were not verified from the source.
